meta.name: bootstrap-memory-ingest-cloud
meta.description: Write structured memory entries to the Cloud workspace via gaai_memory.store MCP tool with source='bootstrap'. Loops over entries from bootstrap-llm-synthesis, calls the tool per entry, collects success/fail counts. Used as Stage 5 of the /gaai:bootstrap pipeline (Cloud path only).
